chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: The one who finds the coolness of our love upon his heart, let him recite prayer in abundance for his mother, for indeed, she did not betray his father.

key_terms.حُبِّنَا: Our love (referring to the love of the Imams)

ai.seo_question: Why should one supplicate for their mother according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) connects the spiritual comfort ('coolness of the eyes') derived from love for the Imams to the virtue of supplicating for their mothers, specifically highlighting the fidelity of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) to Imam Ali. This establishes a theological link between familial loyalty in the Ahl al-Bayt and the believer's own spiritual state, suggesting that honoring the matriarchs of the Imams is a means of preserving the purity of that love. It underscores the Shia emphasis on the maternal lineage as a source of religious continuity and trustworthiness.
